candidate.definition_en: To perceive or recognize something clearly.
candidate.explanation_ar: يعني تميز حاجة أو تلمحها بوضوح.. بتفهم الفرق بين الحاجات

senses.definition_en: To perceive or recognize something clearly, especially with effort or careful observation.
senses.definition_ar: أن تدرك أو تميّز شيئاً بوضوح، خاصة بعد تدقيق أو بصعوبة.
examples: It is hard to discern the truth.
I could just discern a figure in the darkness.
It is difficult to discern any pattern in these figures.
It is hard to discern the truth.
I could just discern a figure in the darkness.
It is difficult to discern any pattern in these figures.
candidate.mnemonic: كلمة 'Discern' فيها 'Concern'.. لما تهتم بـ 'Concern' معين هتقدر تميزه 'Discern' بوضوح
